description: Racheal Bleicher is the 2026 Democratic candidate for Indiana House District 24, representing Westfield, Carmel, Zionsville, and surrounding communities. A Westfield resident, Racheal lives with her husband, their two young daughters, and their dog Brighton. As a mother and successful business leader, Racheal understands the challenges our families face and will bring real-world experience and integrity to the Statehouse. She is running to protect our personal freedoms, support working families, and build a stronger, fairer future for our community. Her opponent, Hunter Smith, has failed to hold his own party accountable and fairly represent all the constituents of Indiana House District 24.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Racheal for Indiana
